def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])

    # Find the centers of the colored tiles (the cells that are neither
    # background nor the common tile color).
    marker_colors = {v for row in g for v in row if v not in (0, 4)}
    if not marker_colors:
        return g

    # Centers lie on a regular lattice. Infer its row/column coordinates
    # from the marker positions.
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if g[r][c] in marker_colors]
    rows = sorted(set(r for r, c in points))
    cols = sorted(set(c for r, c in points))

    # For each marker, connect to the nearest marker of the same color in
    # each cardinal direction. Other-color markers do not block a line;
    # existing tile cells are preserved.
    for r, c in points:
        color = g[r][c]
        for dr, dc in ((0, 1), (0, -1), (1, 0), (-1, 0)):
            rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                if g[rr][cc] == color:
                    step_r, step_c = dr, dc
                    ar, ac = r + step_r, c + step_c
                    while (ar, ac) != (rr, cc):
                        if g[ar][ac] == 0:
                            g[ar][ac] = color
                        ar += step_r
                        ac += step_c
                    break
                rr += dr
                cc += dc
    return g
